description: OMENZ Link Check: where does this link really go, and is it safe to follow, sign in or pay? Follows the redirect chain hop by hop (unshortens bit.ly/tinyurl etc.), then checks the destination: TLS certificate (valid, issuer, days to expiry, hostname match), destination domain age (RDAP), plain http, page status. DANGER (bad/expired cert, new domain < 30 days, redirect loop, private-network target) / CAUTION (shortener, lands on a different site than shown, http, expiring cert, many hops, 4xx/5xx) / UNREACHABLE / OK. Never submits forms, runs scripts or pays. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/link/check, $0.003 via x402.)
name: link_check
